question: What intense experience at the tip of nectar affects even the wise practitioner?
premises: The practice involves the tip of nectar
There is contact with the tip of essence
Even a wise person experiences burning
inference: Even the wise practitioner experiences a burning sensation at the tip of nectar through the tip of essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are yogic and context-specific.
plain_english: Even the wise one experiences burning at the tip of nectar by means of the tip of essence.
